newsitem.title: USA: Volkswagen to reopen Delaware facility.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen to reopen Delaware facility.

text.p: The International Brotherhood of Teamsters said on Monday that Volkswagen announced it will reopen a Wilmington port facility for processing the company's imported cars.
Volkswagen made the announcement Friday at a news conference attended by Delaware Gov. Tom Carper and a representative of Teamsters Local 326, the union said.
Volkswagen had shut the facility in August. The company has now agreed to keep it open for at least three years, the Teamsters said.
